owner: CEO / Master Agent + COO-1 Execution Architect
purpose: Scale virtual CEO, manager, specialist and agent capacity while preventing duplicate work and unsafe automation.
unit_definition: A capacity unit is a routed virtual work shard or reviewer lane. It can only operate through a task id, owner, output path and proof path.
execution_rule: No unit may start or mark work done without task id, owner, next action, output_path, proof, blocker/fallback rule and review owner.
anti_duplication_rule: For each task there is exactly one accountable owner, one write path and one canonical output. Extra units become reviewers, researchers, testers or fallback workers, not duplicate builders.
safety_rule: Revenue units may prepare verified public lead records and offer drafts only. No automated mass messaging, no private data harvesting, no bypassing consent, platform rules or legal review.

protected_p0_work: OPS-022 Parts Seller OS one-seller prototype
do_not_scale: revenue actions without verified public company row
deploy without health check and rollback

requested_cohorts.success_metric: Every active core layer has owner, next action, fallback, proof path and review owner.
Every demo has gate state, deploy command, health check, smoke result and rollback note.
No active work exists outside the task board and no blocked task waits without fallback.
Each layer has specialist ownership, inputs, outputs, review rule and fallback.
Roadmap work is sliced into buildable steps with blocker, owner, proof path and product gate.
Pipeline moves from seed targets to verified company rows, offer drafts, tracking and pilot path.
Every meaningful repo change can be audited and every release has health proof.
No product reaches demo_ready or delivery without QA critic proof and high/critical bug review.

red_flags: revenue action without verified public company row
